title: Tarantula Nebula (NGC 2070) in the Large Magellanic Cloud
title_pt: Nebulosa da Tarântula, na Grande Nuvem de Magalhães
description: The Tarantula is the most active star-forming region in our group of galaxies, inside the Large Magellanic Cloud, a small galaxy that orbits the Milky Way. It is so bright that if it were as close as the Orion Nebula it would cast shadows on Earth.
